entities.summary: Santiago Castroviejo y Bolíbar was a Spanish botanist. He is credited with identifying and naming 63 species in the IPNI. The abbreviation "Castrov." is used to indicate Santiago Castroviejo as an authority in the scientific description and classification of species.
